title: Bundled table envelope (SPEC REQ-DATA-02)
description: Every bundled table carries this envelope; each table also has its own <table id>.schema.json in this folder. Table ids are lower case, with dots between parts (ref.skills). Root annotations a table schema may add: x-keys (JSON pointer of a row array, * for every member, to the field that is its primary key, unique within each array) and x-prose (field names allowed to hold text longer than 80 characters; a cross-table reference is never read from them). A cross-table reference is a string <table id>:<key> without spaces.
